title: Illustration Color
slide_intent: Set the scope of an extended palette. A designer needs to know which hues can enliven an illustration and which colors should hold a series together.
strategic_value: Instacart can add bright accents to drawings while Kale and Cashew maintain a recognizable thread across them.
demonstration: A five-column swatch grid includes the brand colors and an additional labeled row of Illustration Red, Blue, Blush, Yellow and Pink. The note limits the added colors to illustration.
practical_value: Choose drawing accents from the tertiary row while checking the prominence of Kale and Cashew across the color story.

content_islands.name: Palette scope
content_islands.spec: Place the title at upper left and set the usage note across the top, above the samples.

content_islands.name: Swatch grid
content_islands.spec: Build three rows of broad rounded swatches with narrow gutters. Keep the five illustration-only names and their HEX and RGB references inside the bottom row.
